name: WooCommerce Gift Cards
author: WooXperto

sections.description:
WooCommerce Gift Cards plugin is a comprehensive gift card selling plugin. It’s built on top of WooCommerce system. By using WooCommerce Gift Cards plugin store owner can create unlimited gift cards into their online store. This is a most flexible gift card selling system which compatible with all other WooCommerce extensions like- discount, coupon, pricing rules many more. WooCommerce Gift Cards plugin will give you full freedom to manage your gift cards.

🖥️Live Demo: View Demo

Key Features

Our WooCommerce Gift Cards plugin comes with the following features: –

👉 Easy manageable

👉 Gift card is a product type, so that you will get full freedom to use all product features like- sale price, product image, gallery image, categories gift card etc

👉 Can create gift card from admin panel. So that you can sell it in offline

👉 Easy & simplified but vast setting options

👉 Can control gift card pdf footer text

👉 Customize able gift card number pattern

👉 Gift card product layout control

👉 Can control gift card product background style like- solid background color, gradient color, background image

👉 Fully manage able gift card recipient and sender form

👉 Flexible email settings

How WooCommerce Gift Cards plugin works?

👉 Once the gift card is purchased, the recipient receives an email with an attached PDF containing the gift card’s unique code

👉 Automatically generate a unique, secure gift card code for each transaction

👉 Codes are stored securely and can be used multiple times until the full balance is redeemed

👉 Recipients can easily apply the gift card code in the cart or checkout page just like a coupon to reduce their order total

👉 Fully compatible with WooCommerce products discount, taxes, shipping, and others

👉 Easily, admins can manually create custom gift cards from the WordPress gift card dashboard

👉 Admins can view all active and used gift cards from the dashboard

Many more options that will be helpful for your business. Let’s try it out.

WooXperto Team is open for you to give customization support. You might contact us for any kind of help for your gift card plugin.

Let’s Enjoy 😊

sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin Files: Upload the wooCommerce-gift-cards folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the Plugin: Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Install Required Plugins: Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Configure the Plugin: Go to ‘Gift Cards’ under WooCommerce > Products > Gift Cards menu to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
1. Can I customize the gift card email design?

Absolutely. You can modify the email template under WooCommerce email settings.

2. Can I use both fixed and custom gift card amounts?

No! You can only set fixed product price.

3. Can gift cards be used with WooCommerce coupons?

No. Gift cards work independently from WooCommerce coupons. A customer can either use a gift card or a coupon on a single order—both are useable.

4. Can I generate a gift card manually without an order?

Absolutely! Use the Manually Generate Gift Card feature from the admin dashboard.
